title: Delivery management
desc: Manage couriers, their shifts and the cash they handle on each delivery.
no_branches: The delivery module is not assigned to any branch
no_branches_desc: Assign the DOMICILIOS module to a branch from its settings to manage couriers and shifts.
couriers_desc: Branch users with the courier role.
couriers_empty_hint: Create users with the Courier role under People → Users.
shifts_desc: Cash ledger and settlement of every shift.
activate_desc: A shift will open with the base you hand to the courier.
activate_base_hint: Cash you hand to the courier to start the shift.
activate_base_required: Enter the base amount to hand over.
movement_extra_desc: The amount is added to the cash the courier must hold.
movement_pickup_desc: You collect cash from the courier; it reduces the cash they must hold.
movement_amount_invalid: Enter an amount greater than zero.
close_desc: The settlement will be generated: expected cash on hand, the courier's share and the cash to hand back to the company.
cuadre_to_company: Cash to hand back to the company
cuadre_note: The courier's share is the delivery value of delivered orders × the branch delivery value percentage. Tips are not counted.
orders_desc: Orders assigned to branch couriers. Register the delivery and the buyer's payment.
orders_linked_hint: Orders marked «This shift» already record movements in this shift's cash ledger.
deliver_desc: Register the buyer's payment. Payments must add up to the order total.
deliver_return_advance: Return the advance to the courier
deliver_return_advance_hint: The courier paid the order value in advance when taking it; return the advance if the buyer changed the payment method.
deliver_refund_hint: Leave empty to return {{amount}} (total − cash received).
deliver_payments_required: Add at least one payment method.
deliver_amount_invalid: Each payment amount must be greater than zero.
deliver_sum_mismatch: Payments must add up to the order total ({{total}}).
deliver_reference_required: This payment method requires a reference.
assign_desc_one: Choose the courier with an open shift who will deliver this order.
assign_desc_many: Choose the courier with an open shift who will deliver the {{count}} selected orders.
assign_empty: No couriers with an open shift.
assign_multi_branch: The selected orders belong to different branches. Select orders from a single branch to assign them together.
assign_partial: {{ok}} order(s) assigned; {{failed}} could not be assigned.
action_failed: The operation could not be completed.
